rationale: C16 is an almost verbatim predecessor using the same statutory recital, findings, sequence, and operative extension machinery, with Austria substituted for Czechoslovakia and a later expiration date substituted for December 31, 1948. C06 and C04 are also clear instances of the same reusable country-specific trademark-renewal template, but C16 is the latest earlier example and most closely matches the child's wording and surrounding form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas by the act of Congress approved July 17, 1946, 60 Stat. 568, the President is authorized...to grant an extension of time...for the renewal of trade-mark registrations...by nationals of countries which accord substantially equal treatment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas by the act of Congress approved July 17, 1946, 60 Stat. 568, the President is authorized...to grant an extension of time...for the renewal of trade-mark registrations...by nationals of countries which accord substantially equal treatment
shared_material.explanation: The statutory recital is reproduced essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: with respect to trade-marks of nationals of Austria registered in the United States Patent Office which have been subject to renewal on or after September 3, 1939...because of conditions growing out of World War II, such disruption or suspension of facilities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: with respect to trade-marks of nationals of Czechoslovakia registered in the United States Patent Office which have been subject to renewal on or after September 3, 1939...because of conditions growing out of World War II, such disruption or suspension of facilities
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive factual finding and its full drafting structure are reused with only the country changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: that Austria accords substantially equal treatment...and that accordingly the time within which compliance with conditions and formalities...may take place is hereby extended...until and including February 28, 1949
shared_material.parent_excerpt: that Czechoslovakia accords substantially equal treatment...and that accordingly the time within which compliance with conditions and formalities...may take place is hereby extended...until and including December 31, 1948
shared_material.explanation: The reciprocity finding and operative extension are materially identical, with the target country and terminal date adapted.
